content: The Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has been one of the biggest hits for gaming so far this year. With such a beloved video game franchise, there is always a certain amount of apprehension about remakes, especially when it is something that holds a certain level of nostalgia. However, with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, the team at Nintendo clearly took care to reintroduce fans to a beloved world.
